description: Implementation of IEEE 802.15.4 MAC layer including frame handling, transmission, reception, and initialization functions within Zephyr OS.

methods.name: ieee802154_radio_send
methods.description: Handles the transmission of a packet over IEEE 802.15.4 radio, including retries and acknowledgment handling.

methods.name: swap_and_set_pkt_ll_addr
methods.description: Swaps byte order and sets the link-layer address based on addressing mode and PAN ID presence.

methods.name: ieeee802154_check_dst_addr
methods.description: Checks if the destination address of a frame matches the device's address and filtering criteria.

methods.name: ieee802154_recv
methods.description: Processes received IEEE 802.15.4 frames, including validation, addressing, acknowledgment, and decapsulation.

methods.name: ieee802154_send
methods.description: Prepares and transmits a packet over IEEE 802.15.4, including fragmentation, header encoding, and actual radio transmission.

methods.name: ieee802154_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the IEEE 802.15.4 interface.

methods.name: ieee802154_flags
methods.description: Returns the current flags/status of the IEEE 802.15.4 interface.

methods.name: ieee802154_init
methods.description: Initializes the IEEE 802.15.4 stack on a network interface, setting addresses, capabilities, and security.
